newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Klaipeda Nafta lights up dull Lithuanian shares.
newsitem.headline: Klaipeda Nafta lights up dull Lithuanian shares.

text.p: Klaipeda Nafta gave a boost to Lithuania's stock exchange by the close on Thursday as 4.25 percent of the company changed hands in an otherwise dull day.
"Unfortunately the market is drifting slowly on a small downward slope," said one broker. "I expect this trend to prevail for rest of the summer."
Official list shares dropped 11.12 points to 882.03 points, while group A shares edged up a modest 4.02 points to 1874.16 litas.
Central market turnover advanced to 656,000 litas from 374,000 litas.
Klaipeda Nafta's 3.74 million litas turnover dominated the block market, with the shares going at 110 litas compared to 151 litas on the central market where turnover was 1,600 litas.
"It (the block trade) was 4.25 percent of Klaipeda Nafta's share capital," said Aiste Kraujalyte, a broker with Vilfima, the brokerage that handled the deal.
Kraujalyte said the buyer and seller were not from Lithuania, but she declined to say who they were.
Klaipeda Nafta, which has an 80 million litas share capital, has been active all week, with 0.875 percent of its share changing hands Monday and 3.375 percent of them trading Tuesday.
Elsewhere, brokers say the declining market is keeping down some of their favourite shares.
Rokishkis Cheese traded at an unchanged 40 litas, but turned over 200,000 litas on the central market.
Brokers say the shares are underpriced and are seen as cheap at this level.
Fridge maker Snaige marched up to 14 litas and saw 126,000 litas turnover on the central market.
Brokers say one large order drove up the price.
The company reported a first quarter loss of 4.2 million litas on sales of 22 million litas but showed profits for April and May.
Last year Snaige had a profit of 624,870 litas on sales of 145.26 million litas.
